 "data": "classDiagram
 %% ==========================================
 %% УЗЛЫ ГРАФА (NODES) И ИХ СВОЙСТВА
 %% ==========================================

 class Person {
 <<Node : Person | ITMO | External>>
 +ID id
 +String orcid [Unique]
 +String openalex_id [Unique]
 +String scopus_id
 +String researcher_id
 +String openreview_id
 +String gscholar_id
 +String dblp_id
 +String name_en
 +String name_ru
 +String first_name_ru
 +String second_name_ru
 +String surname_ru
 +List[String] name_variants
 +List[String] other_names
 +String degree
 +String biography
 +String country
 +String homepage
 +String gitlab_username
 +String linkedin
 +String twitter
 +String wikipedia
 +Integer works_count
 +Integer cited_by_count
 +Integer h_index
 +Integer i10_index
 +JSON counts_by_year
 +String thesis
 +String status
 +Timestamp created_at
 +Timestamp enriched_at
 }

 class Publication {
 <<Node : Publication>>
 +ID id
 +String doi [Unique]
 +String openalex_url
 +String title
 +String journal
 +Date publication_date
 +String abstract
 +String pdf_url
 +String funding
 +Timestamp created_at
 }

 class Department {
 <<Node : Department>>
 +ID id
 +String name_en [Unique]
 +String name_ru
 +List[String] name_variants
 }

 class Organization {
 <<Node : Organization>>
 +String name [Unique]
 +String ror_id
 +String country
 +String type
 }

 class Repository {
 <<Node : Repository>>
 +ID id
 +String url [Unique]
 +String name
 +String description
 +Integer stars_num
 +String license
 +Boolean has_readme
 +Date access_date
 +Date last_updated
 +Date created_at
 }

 class GitHubAccount {
 <<Node : GitHubAccount | User | Org | Bot>>
 +ID id
 +String login [Unique]
 +String url
 +String name
 +List[String] name_variants
 +String company
 +String location
 +String bio
 +String blog
 +String twitter
 +List[String] commit_names
 +String source
 +Timestamp harvested_at
 }

 class Email {
 <<Node : Email>>
 +String address [Unique]
 }

 class Topic {
 <<Node : Topic>>
 +String name [Unique]
 +String field
 }

 %% ==========================================
 %% СВЯЗИ ГРАФА (RELATIONSHIPS) И ИХ СВОЙСТВА
 %% ==========================================

 %% Академические связи
 Person \"1..*\" --> \"0..*\" Publication : AUTHORED {author_position=Int, is_corresponding=Bool, affiliation_string=Str}
 Person \"0..*\" --> \"0..*\" Department : AFFILIATED_WITH {status=Str, role=Str}
 Person \"0..*\" --> \"0..*\" Organization : EMPLOYED_BY / EDUCATED_AT {start_year=Int, end_year=Int, role=Str}
 Person \"0..*\" --> \"0..*\" Topic : RESEARCHES {count=Int}

 %% Код и репозитории
 Publication \"0..*\" --> \"0..*\" Repository : CITES_REPO {url=Str, host=Str, context=Str, page=Int, is_relevant=Bool, llm_conf=Float, llm_reason=Str, extracted_at=TS}
 GitHubAccount \"1\" --> \"0..*\" Repository : OWNS / CONTRIBUTED_TO {role=Str}
 Department \"0..1\" --> \"0..*\" Repository : MANAGES_REPO
 Repository \"0..*\" --> \"0..1\" Publication : IMPLEMENTS
 Department \"0..*\" --> \"1\" Organization : PART_OF

 %% Склейка профилей (Entity Resolution) и контакты
 Person \"0..1\" ..> \"0..*\" GitHubAccount : MATCHED_GITHUB {score=Float, decision=Str, confidence=Str, signals=List, evidence=JSON, matched_at=TS}
 Person \"0..1\" --> \"0..*\" Email : HAS_EMAIL {source=Str, ref=Str, found_at=TS}
 GitHubAccount \"0..1\" --> \"0..*\" Email : HAS_EMAIL {source=Str}",
